im_feishu_app_already_bound: This Feishu Bot is already connected to another Agent. Choose a different Bot or disable its current binding first.
im_feishu_binding_identity_mismatch: The authorized Feishu Bot identity does not match the current binding. Retry with the current Bot or use Replace.
im_feishu_create_instructions: Choose an existing Feishu Bot or create a new one, then confirm the requested permissions.
im_feishu_reauthorize_instructions: Confirm the updated permissions for the current Feishu Bot.
im_feishu_scan_qr_code: Scan this QR code in Feishu
im_feishu_scope_reauth_required: Feishu did not grant every required permission. Retry and approve all requested permissions.
im_feishu_setup_canceled: Feishu setup was canceled. Retry when you are ready.
im_feishu_setup_denied: Feishu authorization was declined. Retry and approve the requested permissions.
im_feishu_setup_expired: This Feishu authorization expired. Retry to scan a new QR code.
im_feishu_setup_failed: Feishu setup failed. Retry or contact the Account owner for help.
im_feishu_setup_owner_restarted: The server restarted during Feishu setup. Retry to generate a new QR code.
im_feishu_upstream_unavailable: The Feishu open platform did not return a usable authorization. Check the Server's network access to Feishu, then retry.
im_slack_app_team_already_bound: This Slack App installation is already connected to another OpenTag Agent. Disconnect that Agent first, or use a different Slack workspace.
im_slack_auth_identity_incomplete: Slack did not identify this authorization as an installed Bot. Start OpenTag Slack again from this Agent.
im_slack_auth_invalid: Slack rejected this authorization. Start OpenTag Slack again from this Agent.
im_slack_auth_invalid_token: Sign in again, then retry adding OpenTag to Slack.
im_slack_binding_forbidden: Only the Account owner can manage this Slack configuration.
im_slack_binding_identity_mismatch: The Slack App, Team, or Bot identity does not match this operation. Reauthorize the current OpenTag Slack installation.
im_slack_binding_provider_immutable: This Agent is connected to a different IM provider. Disable that binding before connecting Slack.
im_slack_configuration_active: Slack configuration is active. A future signed event will verify the App-to-Bot identity before runtime access becomes ready; Request URL verification remains observation-only, and no test message is required to save this generation.
im_slack_configuration_conflict: The Slack binding changed. Start OpenTag Slack again from this Agent.
im_slack_oauth_failed: The Slack authorization flow is invalid or expired. Start it again from this Agent.
im_slack_scope_reauth_required: The installed App is missing required bot scopes. Reauthorize OpenTag Slack and retry.
im_slack_token_revoked: Slack revoked the Bot Token. Reauthorize to install fresh credentials.
im_slack_unable_to_start_authorization: Unable to start OpenTag Slack authorization
im_slack_upstream_unavailable: Slack did not return installation details. Check Slack availability and retry.
